known_gaps.note: Generic material requires a payload key but permits null; concrete adapters and recovery impose narrower object/null rules. Replacement no-legal-selection and revision-zero recovery fields use explicit null.
Turn optional companion keys are omitted when undefined; interaction-envelope wire material uses a JSON round trip that removes undefined before digest. Neither is an implicit null.
Boundary shape permits non-negative receipt revisions, while AuthorityLog semantic intake requires an exact known operation. Committed entry revisions remain positive.
The scene adapter can report pacing and prove a stated surface, but the engine-free projector/ledger and immutable entry select mechanical truth; Phaser phase queues are not portable authority.
Active cutover/shadow selectors are module-level compatibility bindings. They are cleared bridge state, not revisions, frontiers, receipts, retention, or Rust-kernel mechanical truth.
